metadata.case_name: CHAN CHUNG CHUEN v. W. HING CONSTRUCTION CO LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.education_level: educated to junior secondary level in the Mainland

injuries.description: crush injury to his left index finger with pulp loss, bone and flexor tendon exposure and tip loss
source: crush injury to his left index finger. Physical examination revealed pulp loss with bone and flexor tendon exposure over his left index finger.
crushed left index finger resulting in tip loss, ankylosis of distal interphalangeal joint and scarring of doner sites.

manifestations.description: pulp loss with bone and flexor tendon exposure over his left index finger.
gangrene over left index finger pulp.
stiffness, persistent numbness and hyperesthesia over his left index finger
index finger pain for seven to eight hours a day which was particularly severe at night. The pain woke him up two nights per week.
difficulty in using chopsticks or spoons to feed himself.
pulp of the left index finger was slightly colder than the right side.
Left index finger had limitation on its movement.
left hand grip was weaker than the right
loss of sensation over the distal segment of the left index finger.
He said he was in a low mood after the injury.

treatments_received: operation with debridement of wound and reattachment of defected pulp skin (4 January 2002)
operation with debridement and cross finger flap (28 February 2002)
operation for insetting of the flap (14 March 2002)

losses.description: Permanent impairment of left index finger including tip loss, ankylosis of distal interphalangeal joint, stiffness, limited movement, weaker grip and nail deformity.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
